Reading "everything on the plate" as the items on the plate itself, I counted an English muffin with cheese (and possibly ham or bacon) and a poached egg. The coffee and sugar packet are not on the plate, so I left them out.

- English muffin: about 60 g and 135 kcal.
- Cheese slice: about 20 g and 70 kcal.
- Poached egg: about 50 g and 72 kcal.
- Possible ham or bacon: about 10 g and 15 kcal.

Total is roughly 290 kcal over about 140 g.
